column2: [intro]
In this world, opinions clash and fight,
People argue and recount their plight,
But I stay here, having my fun,
For debates are just part of my run.
We argue, oh yes, sparks fly,
But I enjoy myself, it's my high,
People can't stand to admit they might,
Be wrong, perhaps, in their sight.
A differing opinion, and it’s a war,
Everyone thinks they hold the truth, for sure,
But I take a step back and laugh with glee,
Harmony’s found in diversity.
We argue, oh yes, sparks fly,
But I enjoy myself, it’s my high,
People can’t stand to admit they might,
Be wrong, perhaps, in their sight.
[ solo ]
We argue, oh yes, sparks fly,
But I enjoy myself, it's my high,
In a world where all is debate,
Let’s laugh together, that’s our fate.
[outro]
